newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch govt says unaware of Fokker-Samsung deal.
newsitem.headline: Dutch govt says unaware of Fokker-Samsung deal.

text.p: A Dutch government spokesman said on Sunday he was not aware of any agreement on the takeover of bankrupt Dutch plane maker Fokker NV by South Korea's Samsung Aerospace Industries.
"There is no memorandum of understanding in preparation at this moment," Economics Ministry spokesman Luuc van Zijp said.

Earlier on Sunday Dutch television said Samsung negotiators, the Dutch government and administrators appointed to run Fokker had set out broad terms for a takeover of Fokker in a memorandum of understanding drawn up on Friday.
Asked if the television report was accurate, Van Zijp said: "I don't think so, unless the NOS news knows more than we do."
At the office of Fokker's administrators, nobody was available for comment on Sunday evening.
